sources.claim: Timer expiration removes one stack rather than the whole buff.
Announces one stack lost at timer expiry; includes Huckleberry. This does not establish Huckleberry damage values.

timer_policy.note: The source gives the buff duration and one-stack expiration, not a separate measured post-first-decay interval. This template repeats the corresponding normal/enhanced timer after each decay. Full x3 expiration is therefore 13.5 / 15 seconds from the last refresh.

content_policies: Only a confirmed kill with owner, weapon instance and explicit weapon_kill credit grants a stack.
Stowed equipped weapons keep counting down and may finish an in-flight kill; detaching the perk clears both variant buffs.
Normal and enhanced use two timer definitions with one shared damage bundle. A socket change first removes the old source and its buff.
Direct weapon damage samples the tier at on_use; explosive_perk_damage is excluded. Flying attacks retain their earlier snapshot after decay or source removal.
Deadline processing precedes a kill at that timestamp. These lifecycle and sampling choices still need game-specific edge-case calibration.
gaps: Independent timing verification for each post-first-decay interval and enhancement.
Exotic-specific Rampage variants, damage credit exceptions, real D2 weapon taxonomy and archetype calibration.
Automatic player content assembly, persistence across restart and HUD binding.
